native.bitrate: Mandatory LE 1M baseline 1000000, optional 2M / coded S2 500000 / coded S8 125000 separately constrained. Coded payload rate is not uniform packet-airtime rate; historical optional 2M and numerically lowest optional 125k are not baseline defaults.
native.payload_bytes: Actual LL Data PDU payload unknown, 0..251 octets, includes L2CAP fragments but excludes LL header/CRC/MIC. Zero-length empty PDU valid. Actual local TX/remote RX maxima bound it; not GATT value or ATT MTU.
native.ble_bearer: Registered ACL_DATA baseline; advertising, ISO and channel sounding require separate reviewed bearer profiles and remain unverified, not compared with ACL timing.
native.ble_tx_phy: Transmit-direction PHY baseline LE_1M, optional peer/local capabilities unknown. PHY and selected effective payload bitrate must agree.
native.ble_rx_phy: Actual receive PHY unknown, can differ from TX. No automatic bidirectional equality.
native.ble_2m_supported: Actual local optional 2M capability unknown; false disallows local TX/RX 2M.
native.ble_coded_supported: Actual local coded capability unknown; false disallows coded TX/RX and constrains local length-time management.
native.ble_remote_2m_supported: Actual remote optional 2M capability independently unknown; false disallows 2M selected peer path.
native.ble_remote_coded_supported: Actual remote coded capability independently unknown; no silent inference from local capability.
native.ble_dle_supported: Actual local Data Length Extension feature unknown; false fixes connection maxima to 27 octets.
native.ble_short_intervals_supported: Actual optional Core 6.2 shorter interval support unknown; false restricts interval set to BASELINE.
native.ble_subrating_supported: Actual local subrating support unknown; false permits factor 1 only.
native.ble_interval_set: Mandatory baseline connection interval set proposed. Optional ROUNDED/EXTENDED sets require actual 6.2 feature evidence.
native.ble_connection_interval_us: No universal controller interval default. Lowest selected set proposal BASELINE 7500 us /1250-us grid, ROUNDED 1250 us /1250-us grid, EXTENDED 375 us /125-us grid; <=4 s. Condition unknown leaves value open.
native.ble_peripheral_latency: Actual skipped subrated events unknown, integer 0..499. Subrate*(latency+1)<=500 and strict supervision bound required; not retry count or milliseconds.
native.ble_subrate_factor: Standard new-connection factor 1 proposed; 1..500 when actually supported. Existing actual factor preserved; no inferred current connection state.
native.ble_continuation_number: New-connection standard zero proposed; integer 0..subrateFactor-1. Not application queue depth.
native.ble_supervision_timeout_ms: Actual timeout unknown, 100..32000 ms in 10-ms increments. Must be strictly greater than twice interval*subrate*(latency+1); unconditional minimum 100 invalid for some connections.
native.ble_ifs_us: Initial standard 150-us frame space proposal; Core 6.0+ may negotiate separately per direction/PHY. Actual frame-space update and schedule remain unverified.
native.ble_encryption_active: Actual encryption state unknown, neither true nor false silently confirmed. MIC4 present only nonempty encrypted PDU; LL length includes MIC, payload limit excludes it.
native.ble_local_max_tx_octets: Actual per-connection local TX payload capability 27..251 unknown; no DLE =>27, <=local supported TX max. Different from actual message length.
native.ble_local_max_rx_octets: Actual per-connection local RX payload capability 27..251 unknown, independent direction and hardware support.
native.ble_remote_max_tx_octets: Actual remote reported TX capability unknown; initial remote baseline27 is not blindly applied to established connection.
native.ble_remote_max_rx_octets: Actual remote reported RX capability unknown; effective TX=min(local TX,remote RX), not automatically251.
native.ble_supported_max_tx_octets: Actual invariant local hardware supported TX capability unknown, 27..251 with optional DLE.
native.ble_supported_max_rx_octets: Actual invariant local hardware supported RX capability independently unknown.
native.ble_local_max_tx_time_us: Actual local per-connection TX bound unknown, 328..17040 us feature-dependent table4.8. No-coded/no-DLE/no-CTE =>328; CTE336; DLE2120/2128; coded/no-DLE<=2704. Max octets and time need not describe identical packet airtime.
native.ble_local_max_rx_time_us: Actual local per-connection RX bound unknown with local feature constraints and supported RX ceiling; not copied from TX.
native.ble_remote_max_tx_time_us: Actual remote reported TX bound unknown 328..17040 us; remote feature completeness remains evidence requirement.
native.ble_remote_max_rx_time_us: Actual remote reported RX bound independently unknown; no local feature assumption or fake negotiated min.
native.ble_supported_max_tx_time_us: Actual invariant local hardware TX timing capability unknown, same table4.8 feature-dependent bounds.
native.ble_supported_max_rx_time_us: Actual invariant local hardware RX timing capability independently unknown.
native.ble_used_channel_count: Actual used data channels unknown, 2..37; channel classification/mapping and hopping schedule not invented. Not the 3 primary advertising channels.
native.ble_central_node_id: Actual scheduling central identity unknown; not default controller or automotive ECU.
native.ble_peripheral_node_id: Actual peripheral identity unknown; independent from central and transmitter direction.
native.ble_cte_supported: Actual local data-channel Constant Tone Extension support unknown, affects length-time table limits; no channel-sounding or antenna array execution assumed.
